description: This Java source file defines a REST controller named PercentController that provides endpoints for percentage calculations, modulo operations, and power computations. It handles HTTP GET requests with input validation, error handling, and mathematical computations using BigDecimal.

classes.name: PercentController
classes.description: A REST controller providing endpoints for percentage calculations, modulo, and power functions, with comprehensive input validation and mathematical logic.

methods.name: percent
methods.description: Calculates (a / 100) * b based on input query parameters 'a' and 'b', returning the result or an error message on invalid input.

methods.name: modulo
methods.description: Calculates a % b for decimal inputs provided as query parameters, with validation for missing, invalid, or zero divisor.

methods.name: power
methods.description: Computes a^b for decimal inputs, with special handling for 0^0 and validation against invalid domains such as negative bases with non-integer exponents.

methods.name: isIntegerValue
methods.description: Checks if a BigDecimal has no fractional part, used to validate the base in power calculations.
